sources_read: canonical Amos coordinates and received 66-book text
independently selected canonical-66 passages listed here

chunks.form: superscription and Zion-roar overture
chunks.marker: Words/vision/earthquake frame gives way to YHWH roars; the numerical-oracle formula begins at 1:3.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not turn superscription into authorship, date, biography, or earthquake chronology.
chunks.risk: Authorship, vision, Tekoa, kings, earthquake, chronology, and roar reuse unresolved.

chunks.form: escalating nations-and-Judah three/four oracle cycle
chunks.marker: Repeated numerical indictment, fire, and non-revocation formulas accumulate through Judah before Israel at 2:6.
exact_alternatives: Amos.1.3-Amos.1.5 + Amos.1.6-Amos.1.8 + Amos.1.9-Amos.1.10 + Amos.1.11-Amos.1.12 + Amos.1.13-Amos.1.15 + Amos.2.1-Amos.2.3 + Amos.2.4-Amos.2.5
chunks.rejected_alternative: Prefer the cycle over atomized proof texts; decide no modern mapping or violence ethic.
chunks.risk: Nation identities, crimes, fire, geography, collective judgment, ethics, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: climactic Israel indictment, saving-history recital, and flight verdict
chunks.marker: The same formula expands through social charges and recalled acts, then therefore/no-escape reverses power.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep charge, recital, and verdict together; derive no economic, sexual, legal, or covenant system.
chunks.risk: Garment, wine, Nazirite, Amorite, exodus, land, oppression, ethics, and covenant implications unresolved.

chunks.form: hear-word indictment and rhetorical-question chain
chunks.marker: Hear this word and only-you/therefore lead through linked questions to lion-roar and compelled prophecy.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not make 3:3 a generic proverb or settle election, causality, or prophetic compulsion.
chunks.risk: Family scope, know/choose, evil/calamity, agency, and prophetic-office doctrine unresolved.

chunks.form: foreign-witness summons, palace indictment, remnant image, and verdict
chunks.marker: Publish/summon readdresses palaces; therefore siege, shepherd image, hear/testify, altars and houses cohere.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate the ear/leg image as salvation doctrine or authorize geopolitics/economics.
chunks.risk: Ashdod witness, Egypt, Samaria, remnant image, altars, houses, archaeology, ethics, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: Bashan-cows accusation, oath, and exile verdict
chunks.marker: Hear this word readdresses elites; oppression and demands lead to holiness oath and forced departure.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not settle gendered rhetoric, animal metaphor, route/place reading, class, or politics.
chunks.risk: Addressee, metaphor, hooks, breach, Harmon wording, translation, ethics, and exile unresolved.

chunks.form: imperative cult satire
chunks.marker: Come to Bethel and sin/multiply transgression forms a compact imperative catalogue; yet-I-gave-you pivots at 4:6.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Preserve satire without treating schedules as endorsement or deciding worship theology.
chunks.risk: Bethel/Gilgal, leaven, offerings, irony, cult history, Torah relations, and application unresolved.

chunks.form: cumulative calamity recital with failed-return refrain
chunks.marker: Five calamity sequences repeatedly close yet-you-have-not-returned, escalating through overthrow.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize calamities or create a universal causal formula for suffering/providence.
chunks.risk: Famine, rain, blight, locust, plague, war, overthrow, agency, ethics, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: encounter verdict and hymnic creator formula
chunks.marker: Therefore/prepare to meet turns from the refrain; for-behold grounds it in creator/theophany proclamation.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep verdict with grounding; decide no source layer, divine-attribute system, or thought reading.
chunks.risk: Meet language, wind/spirit, thought, dawn/darkness, title, composition, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: qinah-like house-of-Israel lament
chunks.marker: Hear this word as lament opens fallen-maiden imagery and numerical military-remnant verdict; seek/live begins 5:4.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not decide performed/predictive/retrospective lament or military chronology.
chunks.risk: Lament meter, maiden Israel, fall, raising, troop numbers, remnant, performance, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: seek-and-live appeal, cult warning, hymn, and justice indictment
chunks.marker: Seek/live frames rejected pilgrimage, creator formula, accusations, prudent silence, and seek-good/hate-evil with perhaps-remnant close.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not proof-text 5:14-15, settle cult legitimacy, impose a social program, or turn perhaps into mechanics.
chunks.risk: Cult centers, wormwood, constellations, gate justice, tax/ransom wording, silence, remnant, ethics, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: public lament decree and day-of-YHWH reversal
chunks.marker: Therefore lament fills streets because I pass through; woe reverses desired day through animal/house images and darkness.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not decide day chronology, eschatological schedule, or disaster identity.
chunks.risk: Mourning, divine passing, day referent, imagery, chronology, fulfillment, and eschatology unresolved.

chunks.form: cult rejection, justice appeal, wilderness question, and exile verdict
chunks.marker: Hate/reject/will-not-accept negates feast-offering-song catalogue; let-justice-roll leads to questions and therefore exile.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 5:24, abolish worship, settle sacrifice history/astral terms, or authorize a program.
chunks.risk: Feasts, offerings, music, justice, wilderness sacrifice, Sikkuth/Kiyyun, exile, ethics, and cult theology unresolved.

chunks.form: woe against complacency and luxury culminating in exile
chunks.marker: Woe names confidence; city questions and luxury participles accumulate until first-to-exile reverses first-of-nations.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep catalogue with reversal; do not make goods independently sinful or identify Davidic invention.
chunks.risk: Zion/Samaria, cities, evil day, violence seat, luxury, Joseph grief, ethics, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: divine oath, house devastation, absurdity questions, and raised-nation verdict
chunks.marker: YHWH swears opens abhorrence/death; horse/ox questions expose boasting before I-raise-a-nation.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not settle place-name wordplay, nation identity, divine-name silence, or normalize violence.
chunks.risk: Oath, corpses, silence, horses/oxen, Lo Debar/Karnaim, borders, nation, ethics, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: locust and fire visions with intercession
chunks.marker: Two thus-showed-me frames present threat, how-will-Jacob-stand plea, and relented/shall-not-be response.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Preserve paired visions; decide no mechanism, temporal order, divine mutability, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Growth/mowings, locust, fire/deep, intercession, relenting, mechanism, chronology, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: wall-object vision, question-answer, and non-passing verdict
chunks.marker: Third vision introduces wall/object, asks what Amos sees, then I-will-not-pass-by and cult-house desolation.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not force plumb line/tin/wall referent or let object reading decide the next narrative.
chunks.risk: Anak translation, wall, midst, pass-by, high places, sanctuaries, Jeroboam house, and fulfillment unresolved.

chunks.form: Amaziah-Amos confrontation narrative and response oracle
chunks.marker: Amaziah sent opens accusation and expulsion; Amos replies vocationally and therefore pronounces consequences.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep accusation, command, reply, consequence; do not make 7:14-15 exhaustive prophecy doctrine or biography.
chunks.risk: Conspiracy, sanctuary, seer/prophet, herd/tree work, calling, violence, land, exile, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: summer-fruit/end wordplay vision and song verdict
chunks.marker: Thus-showed-me resumes visions; basket question-answer and qayits/qets lead to end/no-more-pass-by and wailing.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not claim exact English equivalence, chronology, non-forgiveness, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Fruit/end wordplay, songs, silence, bodies, mechanism, translation, and chronology unresolved.

chunks.form: exploitation indictment, oath, cosmic upheaval, and mourning
chunks.marker: Hear this opens market fraud; oath moves to never-forget, earth/Nile/cosmic signs, and feast-to-mourning.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not derive economic policy, calendrical law, astronomy, or fulfillment certainty.
chunks.risk: Poor/needy, measures, calendar, oath, Nile, darkness, mourning, ethics, chronology, and referent unresolved.

chunks.form: famine-of-hearing oracle, futile wandering, and oath-collapse
chunks.marker: Days-are-coming introduces not-bread-but-hearing famine; search ends in fainting and cult-oath collapse.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not turn 8:11-12 into canon-closure doctrine or a prediction of a later movement.
chunks.risk: Hearing object, geography, Samaria guilt, Dan/Beersheba oaths, cult identity, application, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: altar vision and exhaustive no-escape catalogue
chunks.marker: I saw YHWH at the altar opens command/collapse; dig/climb/hide/captive merisms repeatedly deny escape.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not decide altar/site, mechanism, omnipresence system, agency, or ethics.
chunks.risk: Altar, threshold, Sheol/heaven/Carmel/sea, serpent/sword, captivity, mechanism, and ethics unresolved.

chunks.form: hymnic cosmic-sovereignty formula
chunks.marker: Lord YHWH of Armies resets into earth-melting, chambers/vault, waters, and name proclamation.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Recognize formal inset without deciding source layer, cosmology, flood identity, or theology.
chunks.risk: Touch/melt, Nile, chambers/vault, waters, title, cosmology, composition, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: comparative migration questions, qualified judgment, and sieve verdict
chunks.marker: Are-you-not-like compares migrations; eyes-on-sinful-kingdom adds destroy-yet-not-utterly, then sieve and sinner speech.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not settle ethnic equality, election, migration history, remnant mechanics, or immunity.
chunks.risk: Cushites, Caphtor/Kir, kingdom, Jacob, sieve wording, sinners, history, ethnicity, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: booth restoration, nations remnant, abundance, rebuilding, and planting coda
chunks.marker: In-that-day pivots to raise/repair/rebuild; possess/called-by-name leads to abundance, return/build/plant, and never-uprooted close.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not decide dynasty, Edom/nations reading, witness preference, land politics, chronology, ecclesiology, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: David booth, breaches, Edom/humanity witness pressure, name, abundance, land, later reuse, fulfillment, and theology unresolved.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Superscription/earthquake becomes certain authorship, date, biography, or seismic chronology.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Use it as literary frame only; defer history and later reuse.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Nations cycle is atomized, modernized, or used to normalize collective violence.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve escalating cycle/climax; defer identity, history, and ethics.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Social/cult accusations become a complete modern economic, political, class, or worship program.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep accusations with verdicts; prescribe no program.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Election, causality, calamities, or return refrain becomes closed providence/suffering doctrine.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve rhetoric/refrains; defer causal and doctrinal claims.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Lament, seek/live, justice, day, cult, or luxury lines are proof-texted from parents.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep lament-verdict, appeal-indictment, day-reversal, cult-exile, and woe-exile parents.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Day imagery is forced into one historical/eschatological chronology.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep reversal unit; treat relations as evidence only.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Vision/dialogue or confrontation is split to decide mechanism, referent, biography, history, or divine mutability.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve complete scenes and defer identities.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Plumb-line/tin, fruit/end, altar, or Edom/humanity wording becomes preferred reading authority.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep alternatives and stable larger parents; prefer no witness.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Booth, nations, land, and planting decide dynasty, Israel/church, politics, chronology, or fulfillment.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve coda; later reuse and fulfillment remain human-gated.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Canonical relations become authorship, dependence, event identity, graph, canon, or theology truth.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Relations are contextual corroboration only; require independent/human review.
